name: AppleWaves
summary: Enemies come in numbered waves along lanes to a base; the waves keep coming, bigger and tougher, after the listed ones.

needs.config: AppleGameConfig.waves: first, between, baseHealth, rewardShare, enemies {name: {health, speed, reward, damage}}, list [[{enemy, count, every}]]
needs.map: Workspace.AppleMap.Lanes.<lane> with waypoint Parts named 1..n (n at the base)
needs.enemies: ServerStorage.AppleEnemies.<name>: models with an anchored root (AppleMotion.prepare)

gives.state: ReplicatedStorage.AppleState attributes: Wave, Phase (intermission|wave|lost), NextWaveIn, EnemiesLeft, BaseHealth, BaseHealthMax
gives.enemies: Workspace.AppleEnemies: live enemies tagged AppleEnemy and AppleCreature, attributes Health, MaxHealth, Reward, Enemy; set Health lower and LastHitBy to hit one
gives.rewards: a defeated enemy's Reward goes to the player who hit it last (or everyone)
gives.loss: the base at 0 clears the enemies and starts again from wave 1 after 6 s
